37 Every replay precondition failure yields exactly `{"error":"rejected"}` and changes **nothing**, including high-water counters and capacity. All
successful operations below yield exactly `{"ok":true}` unless a richer result is specified. There is initially no active image and no objects. A
stored context is `(epoch,state)`; its epoch is immutable and refers to a resident image. Advancing a context by a service uses that epoch's image,
not the current active image. It does not alter its source. DENY is sticky. A newly created context consumes one context slot even when denied. A
successful new request in a unit must have a `rid` strictly above that unit's high-water mark, initially zero. Finishing a request does not reset the
mark. Existing contexts are immutable.
38 
39 | op | exact fields besides op | successful effect/result |
40 |---|---|---|
41 | stage | epoch, policy | Compile and atomically install the image; return `{"ok":true,"epoch":E,"image":IMAGE}`. E must exceed every previously
successful stage's epoch. Resident image/cell capacities apply; no partial map installation. |
42 | commit | epoch | Set the active pointer to any resident epoch. Previous images stay resident. Reactivation is allowed. |
43 | retire | epoch | Remove a resident, inactive image only when it has zero references. Successful stages' epoch high-water mark never decreases. |
44 | spawn | unit=U, service | Create a live unit at `(namespace,pid)` with this service, no contexts and request mark zero. No live unit may occupy that
pair; generation must exceed its last successful spawn/clone generation, even after exit. |
45 | clone | parent=U, child=U | Parent must exist at that exact generation. Create child under the spawn identity/capacity rules, inheriting parent's
service, request mark and a **by-value** copy of all contexts. Each copy consumes a context slot and image reference. No service is appended. |
46 | exit | unit=U | Remove that exact live unit and all its contexts. Packets and files survive. |
47 | begin | unit=U, rid | Active image and exact live unit required. Create `(active,START)` advanced once by the unit's service. Return
`{"ok":true,"epoch":E,"state":S}`. |
48 | finish | unit=U, rid | Remove that existing context; return `{"ok":true,"allow":BOOL}`, using complete-path acceptance (false for DENY). |
49 | open | connection=C | Create a connection with no packets and stream mark zero. ID must not be open; generation must exceed its last successful
open, even after close. |
50 | send | unit=U, rid, connection=C, stream, destination | Source context and exact open connection required. Stream must exceed that connection's
mark. Retain a packet with the source context and destination, set the mark, consume one packet slot/reference and return `{"ok":true,"wire":HEX}` as
specified below. Source context stays unchanged; denied contexts may be sent. |
51 | recv | connection=C, stream, unit=U, rid, wire | Packet must exist on the exact connection; unit service must equal its destination. null uses the
retained bytes; explicit wire must be exactly the same 24 bytes encoded as 48 case-insensitive hex characters without spaces. First delivery creates a
context advanced once by receiver service, records `(U,rid)` and returns its epoch/state. Later delivery succeeds only for that **same** `(U,rid)`
while that exact context still exists, returns the same value, and appends nothing. Other duplicates reject, including after finish/exit. A duplicate
does not consume capacity or raise the request mark. |
52 | close | connection=C | Remove exact open connection and all its packets/receipts, releasing packet references. Receiver contexts survive. |
53 | store | unit=U, rid, file=F | Snapshot source context into this inode/generation, consuming one file reference. With no current inode, generation
must exceed its last successful store; capacity applies. With a current inode, only its **same** generation can be atomically overwritten, replacing
its old reference. No service is appended. |
54 | load | file=F, unit=U, rid | Exact current file and unit required. Create a context from file's pinned epoch/state, advanced once by reader service;
return its epoch/state. File is unchanged. This is an explicit observable last-writer handoff, not automatic inference or a merge of multiple causes.
|
55 | unlink | file=F | Remove exact current file and release its reference; preserve generation high-water mark. |
56 | inspect | (none) | Return the snapshot below. |
57 
58 Image references count **one per live context copy, retained packet, or current file**. Units, active pointers and receipts add no extra references.
Successful `recv`/`load` create independent references. A packet continues to hold its reference after successful delivery. Generation checks apply to
every operation carrying an identity. Request/stream/generation counters never wrap; an exhausted maximum cannot be incremented. Every
insertion/clone/overwrite and capacity check is atomic. Images/contexts/units/etc. are per job, not shared between jobs.
59 
60 Wire HEX is lowercase network byte order `4s, u32, u32, u32, u32, u32`: ASCII `EMC4`, epoch, source state (including DENY), numeric destination
service label, stream ID, connection generation. Exactly 24 bytes/48 hex characters. The connection ID is supplied by the event and is not in these
bytes. This is a modeled transport tag, not a cryptographic security guarantee.
61 
62 `inspect` returns exactly `{"ok":true,"active":E_OR_NULL,"images":[[epoch,row_count,cell_count,reference_count],...],"units":N,"contexts":N,"connectio
ns":N,"packets":N,"files":N}`. Image entries are in increasing epoch order. Counts concern current resident objects, not historical generations. Every
non-DENY row cell consumes one map cell; flags and DENY entries consume no map cells.
63
